## About

A lean, interactive prototype of a nationwide early-warning system for pesticides (PSM) in
groundwater. The throughline is the analytical chain **site → vulnerability →
prioritisation → monitoring recommendation**, with the emphasis on a transparent,
traceable assessment methodology rather than a polished surface effect. Index weights are
openly adjustable — map, site profile, ranking and scenarios respond live, so the
methodology stays legible instead of being a black box.
